# paperclip_connection_install (Resource)

Manages tool connection installs across agents or companies in Paperclip.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "paperclip_connection_install" "gitea_install" {
  connection_id = paperclip_connection.gitea_conn.id
  target_type   = "agent"
  agent_ids     = [paperclip_agent.engineer.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String)

### Optional

- `agent_ids` (List of String)
- `company_id` (String)
- `target_type` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String)
- `owner_id` (String) Provider ownership identity for the whole install set. Conflicts within one provider configuration are rejected; separate states require external ownership coordination.
